churches.name: Sarang Community Church of Southern California
churches.denomination_detail: Korean American Presbyterian Church — large Korean Presbyterian congregation in Orange County

score_notes.christology: KAPC subscribes to the Westminster Standards — orthodox Trinitarian and Chalcedonian Christology.
score_notes.scripture: Westminster Confession ch. 1 affirms plenary verbal inspiration and inerrancy of Scripture.
score_notes.gender: KAPC restricts the offices of teaching elder, ruling elder, and deacon to qualified men only — male-only ordained officers.
score_notes.leadership: Plurality of male elders (session) under presbyterian polity with accountability to presbytery and General Assembly.
score_notes.soteriology: Westminster Standards — monergistic regeneration, sola fide, sola gratia, sola Scriptura, perseverance of the saints.
score_notes.cultural: KAPC was founded in 1978 at Westminster Seminary as a conservative Korean Presbyterian alternative — strongly resistant to mainline drift.
score_notes.denominational: Korean American Presbyterian Church — founded 1978 on the campus of Westminster Theological Seminary, Philadelphia; the largest overseas Korean Presbyterian denomination.
score_notes.preaching: Korean Presbyterian expository tradition; bilingual ministry.
score_notes.mens_discipleship: Strong Korean Presbyterian male-elder culture; men's fellowships and family worship emphasized.
score_notes.mission: KAPC is active in domestic and global missions, especially throughout Asia.

churches.assessment: Sarang Community Church of Southern California in Anaheim, pastored by Rev. ChangSoo Roh (formerly of Korean Central Presbyterian), is a large congregation of the Korean American Presbyterian Church (KAPC). KAPC was founded in 1978 on the campus of Westminster Theological Seminary in Philadelphia and subscribes to the Westminster Standards.
